messages:
omar: quick thread: proposal to add a compact `RWD-Policy` header (base64-ish compact kv) so SDKs can carry routing hints + intent tags. goal: cleaner quota bucketing across dedicated/fallback pools + predictable console deltas. plan staged telemetry -> opt-in SDK helper -> console dry-run -> default flip. thoughts?
queenie: important to keep header tiny. some edge infra rewrites headers longer than 1kb and drops them. can we keep under ~256 bytes?
ben: prefer structured but compact. maybe compacted msgpack or JSON-min with separators. SDK helper should hide encoding details.
hao: two immediate SDK UX asks: 1) python needs a sync helper for CLI flows (short lived processes), 2) TS needs a builder that doesn't require importing heavy deps. also doc the precedence: explicit API > env var RW_POLICY > legacy implicit.
ui: Console asks: add a "Simulate RWD-Policy" action that can run historical traffic and show per-tenant delta across buckets. show both absolute tokens and % delta. include a small warning when third-party gateways may strip headers.
omar: telemetry-first: emit `routing.policy.signal` with fields: `tenant` (internal id), `sdk_lang`, `policy_present`, `policy_version`, `estimated_tokens`, `resolved_route`. sample 0.5% globally, 5% for canary orgs. PII: none. add `sdk_version` too.
queenie: for binary compatibility: SDKs should default to not sending header. add `client.routing.set_policy({...})` helpers in py/ts/go. library should expose `flush_policy()` for CLI and `policy_eager=true` option to instantiate.
ben: python snippet proposal so folks can test quickly:```py
from redwood import Client
# eager policy handshake + explicit flush for CLIs
client = Client(policy_mode="eager")
client.routing.set_policy({"priority":"gold","tags":["sla:gold","cost:high"]})
client.flush_policy()  # blocks until header is emitted
```
hao: TS equivalent:```ts
const c = new RedwoodClient({policyMode: 'eager'})
c.routing.setPolicy({priority: 'gold', tags: ['sla:gold']})
await c.routing.flushPolicy()
```
ui: Console UX: have a checkbox "Dry-run policy bucketing" and a CTA "Estimate bill delta" which opens a modal showing per-bucket changes and confidence bands. admins can pin tag->quota mappings before enforcement.
sre-bot: scheduled canary: routing-decoder v5 to accept RWD-Policy compact token on 2024-08-10T05:00Z (job 11900).
deploy-bot: canary deploy success  routing-decoder v5 on canary-2, traffic 4%. :white_check_mark: 
ben: edge-case: some customers use connection pooling across tenants (proxy integrations). ensure batcher never mixes tenant policies; add tenant_id into batching key. will add tests.
queenie: sampling tweaks: start canary at 10% sampling for detailed mapping, drop to 0.5% after 2 weeks. track `policy_present_but_unresolved` where client sends header but router maps to fallback.
hao: rollback thresholds: if a tenant sees >6% unexpected delta in billed tokens for 48h, auto disable policy enforcement for that tenant and page SRE. need automation + alert.
omar: action items: 1) ben to draft SDK helper PRs for py/ts/go (helpers + flush APIs), 2) ui to spec Console dry-run tile + modal, 3) queenie to open telemetry PR with schema + sampling, 4) SRE to author rollback automation. I'll write RFC with timeline: telemetry-only (2w) -> opt-in helpers (2w) -> dry-run Console (2w) -> warn-by-default (1w) -> flip default (2w) with org-level opt-out.
ui: will add mockups and copy for "Estimate bill delta". include small explainer about gateways scrubbing headers.
ben: PR opened for py helper + unit tests: https://git.redwood/redwood/py-client/pull/1045 (WIP). reviewers welcome.
hao: I'll add go env var doc `RW_POLICY_MODE` and precedence tests.
omar: thanks all. i'll create cross-team sync invite and drop RFC link here when ready. :thumbsup:
ui: :eyes: ping when mockups live.
